description.value:
You learn to draw on your own vitality to fuel your powers for the duration. Whenever you cast a force power while this effect lasts, you may pay up to half its point cost with hit points instead of force points; your hit point maximum is reduced by the amount spent this way until you finish a long rest.

You may end this effect at any time, and it ends automatically if paying for a power's cost this way would reduce your hit points to 0, causing that power to fail.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 1
